pairs: Et hæc nomina tribuum a finibus aquilonis,
“And these are the names of the tribes, from the parts of the north,
atrium Enan terminus Damasci ad aquilonem,
at the entrance of Enon, to the border of Damascus toward the north,
et erit ei plaga orientalis mare, Dan una.
And from the region of the east to the sea, there will be one portion for Dan.
And beyond the border of Dan, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris, Aser una.
even to the region of the sea, there shall be one portion for Asher.
And beyond the border of Asher,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris,
from the eastern region, even to the region of the sea,
there shall be one portion for Naphtali.
And beyond the border of Naphtali, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris, Manasse una.
even to the region of the sea, there shall be one portion for Manasseh.
And beyond the border of Manasseh, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris, Ephraim una.
even to the region of the sea, there shall be one portion for Ephraim.
And beyond the border of Ephraim, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris, Ruben una.
even to the region of the sea, there shall be one portion for Reuben.
And beyond the border of Reuben, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris, Juda una.
even to the region of the sea, there shall be one portion for Judah.
And beyond the border of Judah,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris,
from the eastern region, even to the region of the sea,
viginti quinque millibus latitudinis et longitudinis,
which you shall separate, twenty-five thousand in width, and in length,
sicuti singulæ partes a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris:
the same as each one of the portions from the eastern region, even to the region of the sea.
et erit sanctuarium in medio ejus.
And the sanctuary shall be in its midst.
The first-fruits, which you shall separate to the Lord,
shall be, in length, twenty-five thousand,
Hæ autem erunt primitiæ sanctuarii sacerdotum,
And these shall be the first-fruits for the sanctuary of the priests: toward the north,
ad aquilonem longitudinis viginti quinque millia,
in length, twenty-five thousand, and toward the sea,
et ad mare latitudinis decem millia,
in width, ten thousand, but also,
sed et ad orientem latitudinis decem millia,
toward the east, in width, ten thousand,
et ad meridiem longitudinis viginti quinque millia:
and toward the south, in length, twenty-five thousand.
et erit sanctuarium Domini in medio ejus.
And the sanctuary of the Lord shall be in its midst.
Sacerdotibus sanctuarium erit de filiis Sadoc,
The sanctuary shall be for the priests from the sons of Zadok,
who observed my ceremonies and did not go astray,
et non erraverunt cum errarent filii Israël,
when the sons of Israel went astray,
just as the Levites also went astray.
Et erunt eis primitiæ de primitiis terræ Sanctum sanctorum,
And so the foremost of the first-fruits of the land, the Holy of Holies,
beside the border of the Levites, shall be for them.
beside the borders of the priests,
The entire length shall be twenty-five thousand,
and the width shall be ten thousand.
And they shall not sell from it,
and the first-fruits of the land shall not be transferred.
For these have been sanctified to the Lord.
Quinque millia autem quæ supersunt in latitudine per viginti quinque millia,
But the five thousand that is left over,
out of the twenty-five thousand in width,
will be a profane place of the city for dwelling and for the suburbs.
et erit civitas in medio ejus.
And the city shall be in the center.
And these shall be its measurements:
Erunt autem suburbana civitatis ad aquilonem,
But the suburbs of the city shall be: to the north,
Quod autem reliquum fuerit in longitudine secundum primitias sanctuarii,
Now what will remain of the length, in accord with the first-fruits of the sanctuary,
and ten thousand in the west,
shall be as the first-fruits of the sanctuary.
et erunt fruges ejus in panes his qui serviunt civitati.
And its produce will be for the bread of those who serve the city.
Servientes autem civitati, operabuntur ex omnibus tribubus Israël.
And those who serve the city will be taken from all the tribes of Israel.
per viginti quinque millia in quadrum,
of the twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand square,
shall be separated as the first-fruits of the sanctuary
and as the possession of the city.
And what will remain shall be for the prince out of every portion of the first-fruits of the sanctuary
principis erit ex omni parte primitiarum sanctuarii,
and of the possession of the city,
et possessionis civitatis e regione viginti quinque millium primitiarum usque ad terminum orientalem:
from the region of the twenty-five thousand of the first-fruits,
But also to the sea from the region of the twenty-five thousand,
even to the border of the sea,
similarly shall be the portion of the prince.
And the first-fruits of the sanctuary,
and the sanctuary of the temple,
Now from the possession of the Levites,
et de possessione civitatis in medio partium principis,
and from the possession of the city,
which are in the midst of the prince’s portions,
whatever is between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin,
shall also belong to the prince.
And for the remainder of the tribes,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam occidentalem,
from the eastern region, even to the western region,
there shall be one portion for Benjamin.
Et contra terminum Benjamin, a plaga orientali usque ad plagam occidentalem, Simeon una.
And opposite the border of Benjamin, from the eastern region, even to the western region, there shall be one portion for Simeon.
And beyond the border of Simeon, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam occidentalem, Issachar una.
even to the western region, there shall be one portion for Issachar.
Et super terminum Issachar, a plaga orientali usque ad plagam occidentalem, Zabulon una.
And beyond the border of Issachar, from the eastern region, even to the western region, there shall be one portion for Zebulun.
And beyond the border of Zebulun, from the eastern region,
a plaga orientali usque ad plagam maris, Gad una.
even to the region of the sea, there shall be one portion for Gad.
And beyond the border of Gad,
toward the southern region, in the meridian,
et erit finis de Thamar usque ad aquas contradictionis Cades:
the last part shall be from Tamar, even to the Waters of Contradiction at Kadesh,
as the inheritance opposite the great sea.
Hæc est terra quam mittetis in sortem tribubus Israël,
This is the land that you shall distribute by lot to the tribes of Israel,
and these shall be their portions,
And these shall be the exits of the city:
you shall measure four thousand and five hundred.
Et portæ civitatis ex nominibus tribuum Israël:
And the gates of the city shall be according to the names of the tribes of Israel.
There shall be three gates from the north:
there shall be four thousand and five hundred.
And there shall be three gates:
you shall measure four thousand and five hundred.
And there shall be three gates:
there shall be four thousand and five hundred,
et nomen civitatis ex illa die,
And the name of the city, from that day, shall be:
‘The Lord is in that very place.’”
